newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends firmer vs dollar, NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends firmer vs dollar, NBH basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed afternoon trade firmer against the dollar on Monday and narrowed the gap that separated it from the central bank's resistance level (bid), dealers said.

The forint closed at 179.50/55 to one dollar, compared with 179.70/75 at midday and 179.45/50 at the opening and the gap that separated it from the central bank's bid was reduced to five pips from some 10 pips at midday.
"The gap opened on client orders (for foreign currencies) and probably some speculation of an expected dollar strenghtening," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
